settings.text:
IKAANYA was born out of a realization that while dance and sports are growing in India, there aren’t many choices when it comes to variety and quality of apparel, more so when we consider specialized wear. IKAANYA (which means “The Graceful One”) is India’s leading platform for gymnastics, dance, and sports apparel, catering to studios, academies, schools and colleges, teams, and other groups. We offer a one-stop-shop for everything needed for training, performances, or events – from daily class wear and performance wear to specialized shoes and accessories.

Kanika Jain, founder of IKAANYA is a mother of twin dancers and gymnasts. She is a seasoned IT professional with over 15 years of experience in working with retail corporations like Target, one of the leading retailers in the US.

Please bookmark this site to see our latest line across various categories and new features that are being added to make your ordering process seamless.

settings.title: Diverse Selection
settings.text: We offer a wide selection across different categories to suit various ages, needs and budget. To bring the best in each category, we work with a number of established suppliers with a proven track record.

settings.title: Global Quality
settings.text: All our products, from basic designs to stunning performance wear, adhere to global quality of materials and finish. These are made in specialist factories with the right expertise.

settings.title: Customized Solutions
settings.text: We offer multiple options for customization including logos, branding or promotions on the apparel. If you have a specific need that isn’t in our catalog, we can source it or even create it through our large network of suppliers

settings.title: Customer Service
settings.text: We want you to be delighted, and we take feedback seriously. We believe in transparency, and all pricing is disclosed up front (no hidden charges)

settings.subtitle: Meet the innovative, driven and creative individuals who power IKAANYA
